english.title: Record information in the register of civil partnership by signing the licence relating to a void partnership
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) recorded in the register of civil partnerships, information relating to the formation of a civil partnership, by the signing of a Registrar General's licence, knowing that the civil partnership between **(..SPECIFY THE NAMES..) was void under section

(A)_[49(b)]_
(B)_[49(c)]_

of the Civil Partnership Act 2004
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(7) and (8) of the Civil Partnership Act 2004.
